detail.longDescription: Quick security check for your live web app: in a private window, open /.env and /.git/HEAD on your domain. A 404 is good (your normal homepage is usually just a fallback). KEY=value lines or "ref: refs/heads/main" mean those files are public. Fix: deploy only your build output (dist/build/out), not the project root, and block dotfiles on the server. If .env was exposed, rotate every key in it. https:// abbilabs.xyz/tips/env-and-git- folder-exposure # infosec # webdev # selfhosted
